landingPage.metaDescription: Landing pages with professional design, persuasive copy, on-page SEO and lightning-fast loading. Ready in up to 5 business days. Request your free proposal.
landingPage.headline: Landing pages built to <destaque>sell</destaque>
landingPage.intro: A single page focused on one goal: turning visitors into leads or customers. We handle the design, copy, speed and tracking — you handle the sales.
incluso: Custom design aligned with your brand
On-page SEO: titles, meta tags and structured data
WhatsApp button and social media links

beneficios.texto: Every section has a job: attract, persuade and drive the click. No distractions pulling visitors off track.
A lightweight, optimized page that opens fast even on mobile connections — so your ad budget isn’t wasted.
Tracking set up from day one, so you know how many visitors became leads.

idealPara: Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns

faq.pergunta: How long does a landing page take?
faq.resposta: Up to 5 business days after the briefing is approved, for most projects. Pages with more complex integrations may take a little longer — the exact timeline is in the proposal.

faq.pergunta: How much does a landing page cost?
faq.resposta: The Starter plan starts at R$ 497. The final price depends on the number of sections, the content and the integrations; you get a detailed proposal within 2 hours.

faq.pergunta: Do I need to provide the copy and images?
faq.resposta: Not necessarily. We can write the copy from the briefing and use licensed stock images. If you already have material, even better.

faq.pergunta: Can I request changes after it’s done?
faq.resposta: Yes. Reviews are unlimited until you approve the launch, and technical support continues for 30 days after delivery.

hotsite.metaTitle: Microsites for Campaigns, Events and Launches
hotsite.metaDescription: Microsites with countdowns, sign-ups, waiting lists and automatic emails for campaigns, events and launches. Request your free proposal.
hotsite.headline: Microsites that make your launch <destaque>happen</destaque>
hotsite.intro: A campaign page with a set date: countdown, sign-ups, waiting list and automatic notifications to keep your audience engaged until the big day.
incluso: Themed design for the campaign or event
Sections for schedule, speakers or offers
Integration with your email marketing tool
Tracking of sign-ups and traffic sources

beneficios.texto: The countdown and limited spots encourage visitors to sign up now, not later.
Everyone who joins the list gets an instant confirmation and arrives at launch already interested.
Follow sign-ups and traffic sources in real time to fine-tune your promotion.

faq.pergunta: What’s the difference between a microsite and a landing page?
faq.resposta: A landing page focuses on an ongoing conversion. A microsite is built for a campaign with a set date and usually has more content: schedule, countdown, sign-ups and automatic communication.

faq.pergunta: Does the microsite stay online after the event?
faq.resposta: Yes, if you want. We can turn it into a recordings page, a next-edition page, or redirect it to another address.

faq.pergunta: How much does a microsite cost?
faq.resposta: The Pro plan, with a microsite and integrations, starts at R$ 997. The final price depends on scope and is detailed in the proposal.

faq.pergunta: Can I export the list of sign-ups?
faq.resposta: Yes. Sign-ups can go straight to your email marketing tool or CRM, or be exported as a spreadsheet.

apis.metaDescription: We connect your page to CRMs, ERPs, WhatsApp Business, Stripe, PagSeguro, Hotmart, RD Station, HubSpot and custom webhooks. Request your proposal.
apis.headline: Your page <destaque>connected</destaque> to your systems
apis.intro: Leads, orders and payments shouldn’t be copied by hand. We integrate your page with the tools you already use so data reaches the right place on its own.
incluso: Mapping of the data and integration flow
Lead delivery to RD Station, HubSpot and other CRMs
Online payments with Stripe, PagSeguro or Hotmart
Messages and notifications via WhatsApp Business

beneficios.texto: Data flows automatically from the page to your CRM, ERP or spreadsheet — no copy and paste.
Your sales team gets the lead instantly and can reach out while interest is high.
Validation and error handling prevent leads from getting lost or duplicated along the way.

idealPara: Companies that use a CRM in their sales process
Online sales with checkout on the page itself
Teams that support customers on WhatsApp
Businesses with in-house systems or an ERP

faq.pergunta: Do you integrate with any system?
faq.resposta: With any system that offers an API or webhook. The most common are RD Station, HubSpot, Stripe, PagSeguro, Hotmart and WhatsApp Business; for others, we review the documentation during the briefing.

faq.pergunta: Can you integrate a page that already exists?
faq.resposta: Yes. We review your current page and tell you in the proposal whether the integration can be done there or whether rebuilding it is worthwhile.

faq.pergunta: Is my customers’ data safe?
faq.resposta: Integrations use encrypted connections (HTTPS) and access keys stay on the server, never exposed in the browser.

faq.pergunta: What if the integration stops working?
faq.resposta: We set up error handling and alerts. During the 30 days of support, we fix any failure at no extra cost.

proposta.metaTitle: Forms with Automatic Proposal Delivery by Email
proposta.metaDescription: A smart form that captures the lead and emails a formatted proposal within seconds, with instant notification and anti-spam. Request your proposal.
proposta.headline: Proposals sent in <destaque>seconds</destaque>, not days
proposta.intro: Your customer fills out the form and gets a formatted proposal by email right away. You’re notified instantly and can focus on closing the deal.
incluso: Instant notification for you or your team
Anti-spam protection that doesn’t get in the customer’s way
Lead delivery to a CRM or spreadsheet (optional)
Delivery tests on the major email providers

beneficios.texto: Customers get an answer while they’re still thinking about your company — not days later.
Every proposal goes out with the same look, the same information and no typos.
Invisible filters block bots without putting obstacles in front of real customers.

idealPara: Companies with a plan or package price list
Sales teams that want to respond faster

faq.pergunta: Can the proposal show different prices based on the customer’s choice?
faq.resposta: Yes. The proposal can change based on the plan, quantity or other options selected in the form.

faq.pergunta: Will the emails land in spam?
faq.resposta: We use a transactional email service and set up your domain’s authentication (SPF, DKIM and DMARC) to maximize inbox delivery.

faq.pergunta: Can I use the form on my current page?
faq.resposta: Yes. The form can be added to a new page or adapted to the site you already have.

faq.pergunta: Who gets notified about a new lead?
faq.resposta: Whoever you choose: one or more emails on your team, and optionally your CRM.

analytics.metaTitle: Analytics and Tracking: GA4, Meta Pixel, GTM and Heatmaps
analytics.metaDescription: Setup and configuration of Google Analytics 4, Meta Pixel with the Conversions API, Google Tag Manager and heatmaps so you know where your leads come from.
analytics.headline: Know exactly <destaque>where</destaque> your customers come from
analytics.intro: We install and configure your measurement tools so every lead, click and sale is recorded — and you invest more in what works.
incluso: Meta Pixel with the Conversions API (CAPI)
Heatmaps and session recordings (Hotjar or similar)
Testing and validation of every event
Guidance on reading the key reports

beneficios.texto: Find out which campaigns and channels bring customers, and cut what only burns budget.
With well-measured conversions, Google’s and Meta’s algorithms optimize your campaigns better.
Heatmaps show where visitors click, how far they scroll and where they give up.

idealPara: Pages that get visits but convert poorly
Companies that never set up measurement

faq.pergunta: Can you set up tracking on an existing site?
faq.resposta: Yes. We can install and organize measurement on pages built by us or by others, as long as we have access to add the scripts.

faq.pergunta: Why use Meta’s Conversions API?
faq.resposta: It sends events from the server as well as the browser. That reduces losses from blockers and privacy restrictions and improves ad optimization.

faq.pergunta: Does the tracking comply with privacy laws (LGPD)?
faq.resposta: We configure measurement according to your site’s privacy policy and can add a cookie notice to record visitor consent.

faq.pergunta: Do I keep access to the accounts?
faq.resposta: Yes. The Analytics, Tag Manager and Pixel accounts are in your name; we only get access to configure them.

hospedagem.metaTitle: Hosting and Deployment with HTTPS, Global CDN and Your Own Domain
hospedagem.metaDescription: We publish your page on your own domain with free SSL, a global CDN, 99.9% uptime and deploys in minutes. Request your free proposal.
hospedagem.headline: Your page live, <destaque>fast and secure</destaque>
hospedagem.intro: We take care of every technical part of going live: domain, security certificate, CDN and monitoring. Your page loads fast anywhere and stays available 24 hours a day.
incluso: Free SSL certificate (HTTPS) with automatic renewal
Deploys in minutes for every update

beneficios.texto: The CDN serves your page from the server closest to each visitor, in Brazil or abroad.
HTTPS on every page: browsers show the padlock and Google favors secure sites.
No complicated hosting panels. You ask for a change and it goes live in minutes.

idealPara: Anyone without a domain or hosting yet
Migrating old sites without losing links

faq.pergunta: Do I need to already have a domain?
faq.resposta: No. We help you register a domain in your name. If you already have one, we just point it to the new page.

faq.pergunta: Will I lose Google rankings when migrating?
faq.resposta: We set up redirects from the old addresses to the new ones, which preserves your links and the relevance you’ve already earned.

faq.pergunta: Can the page handle a lot of simultaneous visits?
faq.resposta: Yes. The CDN spreads the load and absorbs traffic spikes, like those from a campaign or launch.

faq.pergunta: How do I update the page later?
faq.resposta: Send us the change and we publish it in minutes. During the 30 days of support, technical tweaks are included.

Privacy.title: Privacy and Cookie Policy
Privacy.intro: This page explains how Plivaro collects, uses, shares and protects personal data when receiving proposal requests, handling inquiries and operating this website.
summary: We use your data for contact, proposals and support.
Cookies help the site, traffic analysis and advertising.
You can control cookies in your browser.
Requests and questions can be sent by email.

privacidade.p1: Plivaro respects your privacy and processes personal data only for legitimate, disclosed purposes that are compatible with your relationship with us.
privacidade.destaque: When you fill out the proposal form or contact us, we use the information to respond to your request, prepare the commercial proposal and continue assisting you.
coleta: Name, company, email, phone number and message submitted through the site’s forms.
Browsing data, such as IP address, browser, pages visited, visit duration and traffic source.
Cookie identifiers and measurement events, when enabled in your browser.
uso: Responding to inquiries, sending proposals and providing support.
Improving the browsing experience, site performance and content quality.
Measuring campaigns, conversions and the performance of ads and analytics.
Protecting the site against fraud, abuse and misuse.
privacidade.compartilhamento: We may share data with providers that help us operate the site and our customer service, such as hosting, email, traffic analysis, advertising and automation services. When this happens, we require these partners to handle the data securely and only for the contracted purpose.
privacidade.seguranca: We adopt reasonable technical and administrative measures to protect information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure or improper destruction. We keep data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes of this policy, legal obligations and the defense of rights.

cookies.p1: Cookies are small files stored in your browser so the site works properly, remembers preferences and helps measure page usage.
cookies.tiposTitulo: Types of cookies that may be used

tipos.texto: required for navigation, security and form functionality.
help us understand how visitors use the site so we can improve content and speed.
remember preferences and make the experience more convenient.
may be used by tools such as Google Analytics, Google Ads and similar services.

cookies.terceiros: This site may use third-party tools for traffic analysis and advertising, including measurement and advertising scripts. These services may set their own cookies to measure results and improve campaign relevance.
cookies.gerenciar: You can block, delete or configure cookies directly in your browser preferences. If you disable essential cookies, some parts of the site may not work properly.

direitos.p1: Where applicable, you may request information about the data we process and exercise rights related to its use.
lista: Access to, correction and updating of your data.
Request for deletion, restriction of or objection to processing, where applicable.
Withdrawal of consent, when processing relies on that legal basis.

contato.p1: For questions, requests or to exercise rights related to this policy, contact Plivaro at <email></email>.
contato.p2: We may update this document periodically to reflect changes to the site, the tools we use or legal requirements. We recommend reviewing this page from time to time.
